capabilities: Browse books and series in a grid gallery bookshelf view
Extract cover images and manage metadata for PDF, EPUB, and CBZ files
Read books with built-in PDF, EPUB, and CBZ readers
Serve the library to browsers and phones on the local network
Auto-fill series metadata using the Google Gemini API
extras: Installation is manual (in development); detailed usage guides are linked separately rather than included in the README; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the author requests donations.
problem: Obsidian has no native way to browse, read, or manage ebook and manga collections stored as files in a vault.

relations.evidence: Connect your free Google Gemini API key to automatically fetch and fill rich metadata

summary: Visual bookshelf plugin that organizes PDF, EPUB, and CBZ files into libraries with cover extraction, built-in readers, and a local web server.
